items.summary: Recommendation: Reject the proposed allthingsmasonic.com production change this cycle. The available evidence shows 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission in a single low-volume window; attribution and outcome confidence are insufficient for production work. Preserve a bounded public review of affiliate CTA, disclosure, and product-relevance gaps only. Decision question: should the owner authorize that read-only review?
